candidates.requirement: Exercise utf8proc_map with both UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND and UTF8PROC_STRIPCC so generated grapheme sentinels pass through the changed normalization behavior.
candidates.target_route: Use the existing utf8proc_map call with the combined supported flags and a NUL-terminated input such as the added test’s {0x61,0x0a,0x62,0x01,0x63,0x00}.
candidates.failure_condition: Every existing map call omits STRIPCC; direct STRIPCC normalization omits CHARBOUND. No valid input to those fixed calls generates a boundary sentinel for the changed combined-flags behavior.
candidates.alternative_paths: The normalization shortcuts omit both flags. Supplying -1 directly through the harness’s raw UTF-32 copy does not supply the documented Unicode-codepoint input or exercise sentinel generation by CHARBOUND.
